review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner; independent failure evidence from pane %80
review.decision: Preserve v2 refusals without target evidence and surface unsafe queue directory state independently
review.notes: Synthetic HOME, fake clock and fake driver. Preserve old inode, pin and intent and verify health from a broken queue.

cases.description: An old refused v2 intent cannot authorize input to an unverified new target
cases.setup: Generate a legacy v2 refused intent without a retry target, a same-slot claim with its anchor, and unrelated pending work.
cases.action: Drain on a new pane with a fake driver, repeat, and inspect original evidence.
cases.expected: Original old-target evidence remains and is never submitted. Independent work proceeds exactly once, with no Paste or Enter.

cases.description: Unreadable queue storage retains a recoverable independent health reason
cases.setup: Make the queue directory path a non-directory in a synthetic HOME; observe health before and after producer failure and then after safe repair.
cases.action: Attempt keyed and ordinary enqueue, restore a readable directory, and provide a separately confirmed delivery with a fake clock.
cases.expected: Direct inspection and failed producers expose a queue I/O reason even without a drain or HQ. Healthy directory alone cannot erase the observed issue before confirmed progress.
